card.name: Clinical study design words
card.fires_on: Study-design words in trial descriptions: "crossover" after randomized or placebo-controlled, "enrolled" after study or patients, and "CT" in trial registry numbers (NCT).

modes.label: Crossover
modes.description: The word crossover describing a trial design just before the word study.

modes.label: Enrolled
modes.description: The word enrolled after a study or a patient count, introducing the number of participants.
